items.summary: 1/ big announcement today: we will be releasing an open weight version of muse spark 1.2 soon. we also are releasing muse glimmer, a 30B agentic model with open weights under apache 2.0. muse glimmer can run on 24GB of VRAM without losing agentic reliability. 🧵

items.summary: We just launched Xirp, a vendor-neutral agentic development environment. One place to manage agent sessions across @ClaudeDevs , @GeminiApp CLI, and @OpenAI Codex. 1,300+ @Spotify engineers already use it. Now it's available for you to try. Learn more at xirp.spotify.com . Video
